title: PAICV Splits from PAIGC — New Republican Constitution
reason: Country and year are confirmed correct, and the core organizational split is confirmed: on 19-20 January 1981, following the November 1980 coup in Guinea-Bissau, the Cabo Verdean wing of PAIGC formally renamed itself PAICV under Aristides Pereira, severing ties with Guinea-Bissau (confirmed via Wikipedia and multiple secondary sources). title: Drought Persists into Sixth Year in Some Islands

Cumulative rainfall amounts since the start of the season have generally been average to above average, resulting in favourable moisture conditions for crop establishment and development,' and 'Maize output rebounded in 2022 after five consecutive years of drought.' Food insecurity numbers also fell in 2023 (32,300 people) vs 2022 (46,100), attributed to 'the return to the pre-drought level of maize production in 2022.' This is the direct opposite of the event's claim that 2023 was a 'sixth consecutive failed rainy season.' title: Privatisation and Economic Liberalisation Programme

title: UN Graduates Cabo Verde from Least Developed Country Status
reason: Multiple independent, reliable sources confirm the core claim: Cabo Verde graduated from LDC status in 2007, becoming only the second country ever to do so after Botswana (1994), with the change taking effect on 1 January 2008.
